A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''sensor officer''' served aboard the [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Chimaera/Legends|Chimaera]]'' in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] during the [[battle of the Poln system]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Commander, I have ships at the explosion region. Looks like they're rising out from underground. Midsized fighters, alien design, with underslung&mdash;Commander, those underslung missiles are ''Caldorf VII interceptors.''|The sensor officer|<ref name="Choices of One" />}}
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] [[Imperial officer/Legends|officer]] served aboard the [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Chimaera/Legends|Chimaera]]''<ref name="Choices of One" /> in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]].<ref name="Reader's Companion">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> The ''Chimaera'' was [[Captain/Legends|captained]] by [[Calo Drusan]], and the sensor [[Officer/Legends|officer]] worked out of a crew pit on the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer's]] [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]].<ref name="Choices of One" />

[[File:Chimaera.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The ''Chimaera'']]
When the ''Chimaera'' arrived in the [[Poln system/Legends|Poln system]] after a jaunt to the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]], the sensor officer reported to Captain Drusan that a [[Lost Reef|ship]] which had been shadowing them was nearby, and Drusan grew angry that he had revealed secret information in front of the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer's]] [[Commander/Legends|commander]], [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]]. [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Nuso Esva|Odo]], an important passenger aboard the ''Chimaera'', had earlier theorized that the [[DeepWater-class light freighter|ship]] belonged to the [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] Nuso Esva.<ref name="Choices of One" />

A series of explosions soon rocked the [[Destroyer/Legends|destroyer]], revealing that Odo was in fact Nuso Esva in disguise and Drusan had been in league with him. [[Vertigon gas]] filled the bridge, and Drusan was [[Death/Legends|killed]]. In the ensuing [[Battle of the Poln system|battle]] with Esva's [[Nuso Esva's battle fleet|forces]], the sensor officer reported directly to Pellaeon, even though he was still groggy from the [[Gas/Legends|gas]].<ref name="Choices of One" />

The officer told Pellaeon of an explosion on [[Poln Minor]]'s surface and the [[Poln Minor Chosen squadron|squadron]] of [[Whisperlike fighter|fighters]] that emerged from it, and later of the arrival of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire's]] [[Death Squadron/Legends|Death Squadron]]. Esva's [[Eastern Fleet|fleet]] was subsequently [[Space warfare/Legends|destroyed]] by the forces of Death Squadron.<ref name="Choices of One" />

==Behind the scenes==
A sensor officer also appears in the first chapter of ''[[Choices of One]]'', but this article endeavors to avoid speculating that it is definitely the same individual.<ref name="Choices of One" />
